title: RFC 8200 specifies version 6 of the Internet Protocol and obsoletes RFC 2460
summary: RFC 8200 specifies version 6 of the Internet Protocol and obsoletes RFC 2460.
body: RFC 8200 says it specifies version 6 of the Internet Protocol and that it obsoletes RFC 2460. The source says: "Hinden Obsoletes: 2460 Check Point Software Category: Standards Track July 2017 ISSN: 2070-1721 Internet Protocol, Version 6 (IPv6) Specification Abstract This document specifies version 6 of the Internet Protocol (IPv6)." Version 6 is a specification of the packet protocol. This card does not state an address length, because that figure was not the sentence used here.
said_by: S. Deering and R. Hinden, RFC 8200
